results.name: Marble Cheddar Cheese Bar
results.description:

results.description:

results.name: Extra Old Cheddar Cheese
results.description:
Balderson's Extra Old Cheddar is expertly aged to perfection, delivering a rich, bold flavour with a satisfyingly sharp bite. This premium cheddar boasts a firm texture and crumbly composition, with a distinctive pale yellow hue. Its pronounced, full-bodied taste makes it an ideal choice for those who appreciate a strong, mature cheese. Whether enjoyed on its own, added to a charcuterie board, or incorporated into gourmet recipes, aged cheese offers an indulgent, refined experience for the true cheese connoisseur. Made in Canada with 100% Canadian milk.Since 1881, Balderson has been dedicated to aging premium cheese in Ontario. While the world has evolved, our commitment to quality and craftsmanship remains unchanged. Balderson cheese is a premium brand cherished by Canadians for over 140 years, known for its exceptional taste and meticulous attention to detail.

  • Premium, sharp aged cheddar flavour
  • Drier and crumblier consistency
  • Pale yellow colour
  • Aged 14-18 months
  • Made in Canada with 100% Canadian milk
  • Over 140 years of Canadian cheesemaking heritage
  • Premium brand with exceptional taste
  • 250 g

results.name: Marble Cheestrings
results.description:
Made with 100% real cheese, any way you string ‘em, Black Diamond Cheestrings snacks always promise to be fun and nutritious. These marble cheese strings are a great-tasting blend of white and orange cheeses, and are made with 100% Canadian milk. Eat them straight up or peel them piece by piece— Cheestrings are always fun and nutritious snacks. With no artificial colours or flavours and no added preservatives, like all other Pizza Mozzarella, there’s only one rule of Black Diamond Cheestrings – always play with your food.
